messages:
Marta (PM): Final preflight — we need to reconcile a few tradeoffs before GA: strict SLA wording, automated rollback vs manual, pricing promo limits, and monitoring for prompt regressions. Can each owner confirm their constraint/ask?

Eli (SRE): SLO proposal: 99.9% monthly uptime, p95 <=120ms, p99 <=350ms. Operational constraint: we must ship with automated canary rollback enabled (configurable window 10m) to avoid manual pager loops. Fallback rule: if queued_requests > 50 for 2m OR error_rate > 1% for 3m -> route to quantized-fallback and trigger rollback. I own infra and rollback automation.

Jess (Docs): Docs status: API quickstart + examples done. Open items: 1) automated-rollback section + CLI examples, 2) a one-pager for CS on prompt-regression triage. I'll publish both once Eli gives exact automation flags. PR: https://git.repo/PR/999.

Sanjay (Sales): Sales asks we offer a targeted launch credit (15% for 45 days) but only to named early adopters and subject to a per-account cap. Constraint: Finance wants list + cap before committing. Also need a short reserved-pricing playbook for conversions. I'll own promo and conversion runbook.

Dana (Product Ops): Monitoring constraints: must have prompt_regression_rate by prompt-set (sliding 24h), token_cost_per_request, model_version_error_rate, and e2e canary latency. Also require cost-guardrail alert: daily_estimated_token_spend > threshold -> notify FinOps. I'll own alerts + thresholds. Ops-bot can run rolling smoke and cost checks nightly.

Ops-bot: Nightly canary + cost check scheduled 02:10 UTC. Failure -> post to #eng-sre and rollout dash.

Carla (Legal): Constraint: any SLA carve-outs (HIPAA or custom uptime) require a signed addendum + DPA. Also legal insists SLA definitions avoid "continuous availability" phrasing. Will draft addendum template.

Eli (SRE): Small operational ask: oncall overlap SRE+CS for first 72h. Also recommend a 1-hour automated rollback cool-down (so flips don't oscillate). We'll add a circuit-breaker metric to avoid repeat rollbacks.

Jess (Docs): Adding the circuit-breaker note to the runbook: "auto-rollback disabled for 60m after a rollback event unless manually re-enabled." Will push update to PR/999.

Sanjay (Sales): Fine on promo caps — I'll produce a named-customer list and proposed caps by EOD. For reserved pricing: propose a 12-month commit SKU + step-down discounts; Finance to confirm.

Marta (PM): Owners recap: SLA + rollback automation -> Eli; Docs + CS one-pager -> Jess; Monitoring + cost alerts -> Dana; Promo + reserved path -> Sanjay; Legal addendum -> Carla. I'll maintain the GA checklist and will only flip "Ready" after green from each owner here. Add any final constraints now. :rocket:
